title: Detailed submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Water surface hints -->
  <path d='M5 20 Q15 15 25 20 Q35 25 45 20 Q55 15 65 20 Q75 25 85 20 Q95 15 100 20' fill='none' stroke='#3ac0e8' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M0 28 Q10 23 20 28 Q30 33 40 28 Q50 23 60 28 Q70 33 80 28 Q90 23 100 28' fill='none' stroke='#3ac0e8' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Submarine hull -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='30' ry='16' fill='#e8a020'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='30' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#fce080' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- Hull highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='56' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#f5c040' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Nose cone -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='62' rx='6' ry='14' fill='#d08010'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='62' rx='6' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#f5c040' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Tail section -->
  <path d='M18 62 Q12 55 8 48 L14 52 Q16 58 18 62' fill='#d08010'/>

  <!-- Conning tower (sail) -->
  <rect x='40' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='3' fill='#d08010'/>
  <rect x='40' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#f5c040' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Periscope -->
  <rect x='46' y='26' width='3' height='14' rx='1' fill='#a0d8f0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='26' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#c0e8fc'/>
  <!-- Periscope lens -->
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='27' r='2' fill='#60b8e0'/>

  <!-- Decking on sail -->
  <rect x='42' y='39' width='12' height='2' rx='1' fill='#f5c040'/>

  <!-- Portholes -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='3' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#d0f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='58' r='3' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#d0f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='58' r='3' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#d0f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='3' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#d0f4ff'/>

  <!-- Hull rivets -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='68' r='1' fill='#c07010'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='70' r='1' fill='#c07010'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='71' r='1' fill='#c07010'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='71' r='1' fill='#c07010'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='70' r='1' fill='#c07010'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='68' r='1' fill='#c07010'/>

  <path d='M72 50 Q68 44 63 43 L68 49 Z' fill='#d08010'/>
  <path d='M72 74 Q68 80 63 81 L68 75 Z' fill='#d08010'/>

  <path d='M22 50 Q18 46 14 46 L18 51 Z' fill='#d08010'/>
  <path d='M22 74 Q18 78 14 78 L18 73 Z' fill='#d08010'/>

  <circle cx='86' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#a0e8ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='34' r='1' fill='#a0e8ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='48' r='1.2' fill='#a0e8ff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Front light -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='62' r='3' fill='#f8f050'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='62' r='1.5' fill='#fcffb0'/>

  <!-- Anchor detail on hull -->
  <path d='M50 64 L50 70 M47 67 L53 67 M48 70 Q50 72 52 70' fill='none' stroke='#c07010' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
